name: OpenAI
billing: Check your API organization’s credits and billing before making a paid request. Model access and rate limits depend on your organization.
steps: Sign in to the OpenAI API Platform or create an account there. Select the organization and project you will use.
Open API keys, create a project key with the permissions your application needs, and store it privately on your own machine.
Check the API billing and usage limits for that project. A key alone does not establish paid model access.
